\paragraph{Theorem contract.}
On the open side-two four-cube, after reorienting every incident plaquette so
that a rooted interior link has coefficient $+1$, the centered quotient
Gaussian star covariance has spectrum
$\{0,(239/630)^{\times2},(33/70)^{\times3}\}$.  The minimum external-curvature
form for a prescribed centered star displacement is positive definite with
generalized spectrum
$\{(37/33)^{\times3},(391/239)^{\times2}\}$.  Both statements hold for all
eight interior links and are certified by exact rational identities.  No
nonlinear measure or continuum statement is included.
